name: pdlc
description: File and refine feature proposals as forge issues, and keep read-only local copies of the repositories, for the proposal-intake skill.
long_description: An operator-tool MCP server for one operator (BELAY constitution 1.1.0, ADR-0005). It reads and writes only issues labelled type/proposal in repositories under the configured owner, and fast-forwards read-only local copies. It never closes, deletes or relabels arbitrary issues, and never commits, branches or pushes.

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List the repositories under the configured owner, with description, default branch and whether a local proposal copy exists.

tools.name: repo_status
tools.description: Report a repository's local proposal copy: path, branch, clean or dirty, and commits behind or ahead of the default branch. Fetches; changes no files.

tools.name: sync_repo
tools.description: Create the local proposal copy if absent (blobless clone of the default branch), otherwise fast-forward it. Refuses a dirty, off-branch, diverged or foreign copy and changes nothing.

tools.name: check_setup
tools.description: Check that the repository has the proposal labels and the proposal form on its default branch, in step with the master. Reports; creates nothing. ok:false is a result, not an error.

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: List proposals (issues labelled type/proposal) by status (draft, ready or all), optional search query, and issue state (default open).

tools.name: get_proposal
tools.description: Read one proposal: its sections, labels, status, priority, comments, url and updated_at. Refuses an issue that is not a proposal.

tools.name: create_proposal
tools.description: File a new proposal with the title "Proposal: <feature name>", the given sections, one priority label and the draft or ready status. Refuses when an open proposal has the same title.

tools.name: update_proposal
tools.description: Edit a proposal: replace only the given sections, and optionally the title, priority or status. Refuses as stale when the issue changed since expected_updated_at. Returns the new updated_at.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a proposal. Returns the comment's url and the issue's new updated_at.

tools.name: check_spec_kit
tools.description: Check the repository's Spec Kit in its local copy: initialised, version, supported, script flavour, numbering, and how each specify and clarify hook is handled. Reports; changes nothing. ok:false is a result, not an error.

tools.name: start_spec
tools.description: Start the spec for a ready proposal: run the repository's own branch script as a dry run, create the feature branch in its own worktree, write spec.md from the repository's template with the Input line filled, and move the proposal to spec in progress.

tools.name: get_spec
tools.description: Read a proposal's spec in progress: stage, lock, branch, folder, files, revision, open [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers, whether clarify has run since the start or reopen, and whether the proposal changed since the start.

tools.name: write_spec_file
tools.description: Write one file of the spec in progress: spec.md or checklists/<name>.md, inside the spec folder only, against the revision last read. Refuses outside spec in progress and when the spec changed since that revision.

tools.name: approve_spec
tools.description: Approve the spec in progress: refuse while [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain or clarification has not run, then commit the spec folder, publish the feature branch, and move the proposal to ready to plan with a comment linking the folder.

tools.name: take_latest_spec
tools.description: When the feature branch changed on the forge, bring the published branch into the spec in progress: back up first, keep the author's edits by a three-way merge per file, and list any conflicts for the author to resolve. Publishes nothing and changes no stage.

forge_url.title: Forge URL
forge_url.description: The forge root, such as http://<forge host>:3000. The scheme is used as written; no path.

forge_owner.title: Forge owner
forge_owner.description: The one user account whose repositories the server may address.

forge_token.title: Forge token (pdlc)
forge_token.description: A dedicated forge token named pdlc, with write:issue and read:repository only, used by nothing else.

clone_root.title: Clone folder
clone_root.description: An existing folder for the read-only local copies, one sub-folder per repository. Connect it to the Claude Desktop project.
